_about: Researched profiles for the colleges students compare most: ranking, what it costs, placements, and what's around the campus. Figures carry their sources; distances are approximate road distances and should be checked on a map. Cutoffs come separately, from JoSAA and MCC.

iit_fees.name: IIT Roorkee — institute fees (the common IIT fee structure)

mbbs_fees.name: Careers360 — MBBS fees in government colleges

iit_fees.summary: ₹2 lakh a year tuition (₹1 lakh a semester)
iit_fees.waivers: Free for SC/ST/PwD students and families earning under ₹1 lakh a year; two-thirds off for families earning ₹1–5 lakh.
iit_fees.living: Hostel and mess are extra — roughly ₹35,000–60,000 a year depending on the IIT.

nit_fees.summary: ₹1.25 lakh a year tuition (₹62,500 a semester)
nit_fees.waivers: Free for SC/ST/PwD students and families earning under ₹1 lakh a year; two-thirds off for families earning ₹1–5 lakh.
nit_fees.living: Hostel and mess are extra — roughly ₹40,000–70,000 a year depending on the NIT.

medical_placement.note: Medicine doesn't have campus placements. After MBBS comes a paid one-year internship, then most doctors take NEET-PG to specialise or join government service.
